name: Youhu

tierList.prydwen: Support: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 4-star Glacio Gauntlets Support with a unique niche: 100% Coordinated Attack DMG Amplification on Outro (the single biggest damage type amplifier in the game), plus full-team healing. Randomized 'Antique' (Chime/Ruyi/Ding/Mask) draw system enhancing her Basic Attacks, building toward a 4-Auspice Forte finisher (Poetic Essence).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Frosty Punches (4 hits) / Antique Appraisal (enhanced, consumes drawn Antique).
skills.resonanceSkill: Scroll Divination - Glacio hit + party heal + Lucky Draw (random Antique).
skills.forte: Poetic Essence - at 4 Auspices, hold Basic Attack for a Glacio AoE heal-hit with bonus effects (Antithesis/Double Pun/Triplet/Perfect Rhyme) based on Auspice combination.
skills.liberation: Fortune's Favor - Glacio AoE hit, lets player pick a specific Antique from 4 choices.
skills.intro: Scroll of Wonders - Lucky Draw (random Antique).
skills.outro: Timeless Classics - 100% Coordinated Attack DMG Amplification to next character for 28s.

echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best - 15% team ATK on heal)
Moonlit Clouds (special, 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Best Team (Yinlin)
teams.notes: Yinlin has the highest Coordinated Attack DMG of any character, the most natural pairing.

rotation: Rotation 1 (loops indefinitely): Intro -> Antique Appraisal (instant cancel) -> Ultimate -> Antique Appraisal -> Basic 1-4 -> Skill -> Antique Appraisal -> Outro. Rotation 2 (with 2-4 starting Auspice) swaps in Poetic Essence for a faster loop.
communityNotes: Prydwen: solid full-team healer with a large but very narrow niche buff (Coordinated Attack DMG), only useful with the small pool of Coordinated Attack-heavy characters (Yinlin, Zhezhi, Mortefi); slower attack animations and Concerto-hungry rotation limit her general appeal versus Verina/Shorekeeper.
